author: Inside Edition
description: These were frightening air balloon accidents. In 2015, a hot air balloon attempted an emergency landing in a neighborhood, and neighbors raced to pull the balloon to the ground. In 2019, a San Diego Zoo Safari Park balloon ride got bumpy, causing riders to sway all over the place. In 2021, a balloon basket hit a reservoir and plunged passengers into icy waters. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Frightening Hot Air Balloon Accidents
